correctness.rationale: For clique bouquet with m unit-weight blades k_i, hub and K=sum k_i outer vertices, the linear heat generator -L gives directional derivative D of J(f)=sum_edges |f(u)-f(v)|. On a hub-excluding cut with selected blade counts x_i, independently reconstructed D=X(K-2X)-sum_i[(k_i^2+3k_i+1)x_i-(k_i+3)x_i^2]. D-(K-2k_*-1)J is separately convex (quadratic coefficient k_i+K-2k_* >=0), so its box maximum occurs at complete-blade corners, where it equals 2X(k_*-X)<=0. The smallest whole blade gives equality. Level-set coarea decomposition and triangle inequality on zero-difference edges extend D<=mu J to any real signal. Gronwall then yields N(t)<=exp(mu t), initial derivative gives N(t)=1+mu t+O(t^2), and all-time contraction iff K<=2k_*+1. Independently reconstructed literal-edge Laplacians validated 340 integer blade profiles and 41,370 cut derivatives and inequalities. Finite cases corroborate; the coarea/convexity proof supplies universal quantifiers.
residual_risks: The exponential envelope need not equal exact N(t) at positive times.
Only unit edge conductances, counting vertex masses, ordinary combinatorial Laplacian, all real signals.
